tools.name: prepare_deidentified_export
tools.title: Prepare de-identification export
tools.description: Prepare bounded native dataset tables with fresh subject/sample/cell/sequence pseudonyms and explicit annotation/HLA removal. Review the private subject correspondence before downloading. Original scientific evidence remains unchanged; this is not anonymity or a transformed replay certificate.

accept.description: Explicit private-use acknowledgment for restricted provider data; never permits redistribution.

dataset.description: A dataset of the project by name or id; the one in focus, else the first, if not given.

dropText.description: Remove free-text sample annotations; default true.

what.description: AIRR and clonotype tables, or clonotypes only; default tables.

tools.name: download_deidentified_export
tools.title: Download reviewed de-identification export
tools.description: Download the prepared pseudonymized table ZIP, or explicitly download only its separate PRIVATE identity map. Requires the reviewed token/fingerprint and unchanged project. Never bundles the identity map. Preparation expires after 15 minutes or replacement.

identityMap.description: Download only the private identity map separately; default false downloads the pseudonymized ZIP.

tools.name: export_project_archive
tools.title: Export portable project archive
tools.description: Download the current project, history, immutable results and checkpoints with an exact inventory. Source bytes are opt-in; restricted provider sources are always omitted. No scientific recomputation.

accept.description: Acknowledge private-use restrictions on captured provider evidence; never permits restricted source inclusion.

includeSources.description: Include fingerprint-checked permitted source bytes; default false.

ownSources.description: Explicit authority to include sources with no recorded provider license; default false.

tools.name: inspect_project_archive
tools.title: Inspect portable project archive
tools.description: Verify a local archive's complete bounded inventory without extracting files or executing recipes. Return original project JSON as text and all source statuses.

expected.description: Optional independently retained SHA-256 archive fingerprint.

tools.name: import_project_archive
tools.title: Import portable project archive
tools.description: Verify and import an inspected archive into the library without overwriting a project or conflicting evidence. Open the imported project with verified local source bindings. Opening may rebuild dataset tables; saved analyses are not recomputed. Partial cancellation may leave verified unreferenced files.

accept.description: Acknowledge private-use restrictions on captured provider evidence.

expected.description: Required fingerprint from inspection or an independently trusted record.

tools.name: query_clonotypes
tools.title: Query clonotypes
tools.description: Bounded typed filter over the current definition and QC. Native JSON text preserves numeric tokens; frequencies retain the full table denominator. No inference or SQL.

dataset.description: A dataset of the project by name or id; the one in focus, else the first, if not given.

where.description: Typed filter: all/any/not, or field/op/value. Fields total, samples, id, junction, v, j, locus. Numeric eq/gte/lte; string eq/contains. Depth <=8, nodes <=64.

tools.name: export_html_report
tools.title: Export self-checking HTML report
tools.description: Download explicitly selected saved results, exact tables and replayable certificates. Browser checks embedded bytes only; no scientific recomputation or de-identification.

accept.description: Explicitly acknowledge all selected results' provider terms for private study.

items.description: Supported artifact ID in the current project.

tools.name: create_checkpoint
tools.title: Create analysis checkpoint
tools.description: Keep immutable local analysis settings and attached completed result bytes; no source backup or scientific recomputation.

tools.name: compare_checkpoint
tools.title: Compare analysis checkpoint
tools.description: Compare exact recorded analysis and result evidence. No source verification or inferred biological effects.

against.description: Optional second checkpoint ID; current analysis when absent.

tools.name: recover_checkpoint
tools.title: Recover analysis checkpoint
tools.description: Restore saved analysis settings and missing completed result files, with Undo available. Refuse conflicting bytes; no recomputation or running-job resume.

tools.name: inspect_certificate
tools.title: Inspect an integrity certificate
tools.description: Inventory exact saved result bytes and recorded evidence. No scientific recomputation, source verification or authenticity claim.

accept.description: Explicitly acknowledge provider terms for private study; false by default.

artifact.description: Saved cohort-features, cohort-compare, cohort-counts, batch-qc or motifs artifact in this project.

tools.name: export_certificate
tools.title: Export an integrity certificate
tools.description: Download a saved result's certificate through the visible Reports view. Returns its fingerprint. Captured evidence can contain raw data; provider restrictions apply. No recomputation.

accept.description: Explicitly acknowledge provider terms for private study; false by default.

artifact.description: Supported saved artifact in this project.

tools.name: cohort_example_step
tools.title: Follow a cohort example
tools.description: Run one prescribed step on its matching artificial dataset; keep exact design versions and saved parents. Refuse inference for the fully confounded study.

dataset.description: A dataset of the project by name or id; the one in focus, else the first, if not given.

preset.description: counts-independent, counts-paired, counts-null, counts-unbalanced or counts-confounded

tools.name: screen_batch_qc
tools.title: Screen batch QC
tools.description: Descriptive within-batch sample QC with modified z-scores; no correction or automatic removal.

dataset.description: A dataset of the project by name or id; the one in focus, else the first, if not given.

options.description: {threshold:3.5,minSamples:5}; absolute modified z strictly above threshold. Small groups and zero MAD remain unscored.

samples.description: Every source sample as {name,subject,batch,exclude}; exclude is an explicit reason or empty. At most one included sample per subject per batch.

tools.name: screen_contamination
tools.title: Screen contamination evidence
tools.description: Descriptive exact cross-subject nucleotide sharing in human bulk TRB; no automatic removal or contamination verdict.

dataset.description: A dataset of the project by name or id; the one in focus, else the first, if not given.

pgen.description: Optional compatible saved nucleotide Pgen artifact ID; missing is unknown.

samples.description: 2–64 {name,subject,batch} assignments; reuse subject IDs for repeated samples.

unrelated.description: Explicitly declare distinct IDs represent unrelated subjects.

tools.name: analyze_convergence
tools.title: Analyze subject recurrence and HLA
tools.description: Measure selected motif-group recurrence across unique subjects and conditional HLA enrichment within complete locus-specific typed universes. Full declared BY family; no restriction or antigen-specificity inference.

selection.description: {species: human, samples: [selected names], subjects: [{id, samples, typing: {A: [two explicit allele copies], B: [...]}}], groups: [1–128 saved group IDs], alleles: [0–64 declared two-field HLA targets]}. Every sample belongs to one subject. Empty allele panel gives descriptive recurrence only. Missing/ambiguous typing is unknown.

tools.name: screen_motifs
tools.title: Screen sequence motifs
tools.description: Screen explicit query/background samples for overlapping GLIPH2-style signatures, matched by TRBV gene and junction length. Pooled signature family, conditional Fisher scores and BY; hypotheses, not proven specificity.

dataset.description: A dataset of the project by name or id; the one in focus, else the first, if not given.

options.description: {minK:2,maxK:5,minMembers:3,q:0.05,minFold:2}. Reporting filters do not shrink the pooled correction family.

tools.name: audit_definitions
tools.title: Audit clonotype definitions
tools.description: Recompute a pinned subject-feature comparison under one to five declared alternative junction/V/J definitions, keeping subjects, QC and tests fixed. Descriptive effect/interval summaries and across-audit BY; no p-threshold robustness verdict.

definitions.description: One to five full sequence definitions; only junction and V/J resolution may differ from the parent. Preserve chain/cell/productivity rules.

tools.name: fit_cohort_counts
tools.title: Fit replicated clonotype counts
tools.description: Fit subject-level negative-binomial counts from a saved feature design and its original receptor snapshot, with explicit offsets, optional batch adjustment, per-clone dispersion and BH. Retain failed fits; no pooling or Poisson fallback.

options.description: {minCount:10, minSamples:12, adjustBatch:false, confidence:0.95}. Requires at least twenty-four residual degrees of freedom.

tools.name: compare_cohort
tools.title: Compare cohort groups
tools.description: Compare explicitly selected subject features using the saved independent/paired design, both mean and rank tests, effects and marginal intervals, and one BH family. No subject deletion or pooling.

options.description: {features: [feature IDs], confidence: 0.95, permutations: 9999, seed: 20261025}. Select 1–13 features explicitly; confidence 0.8–0.99; permutations 999–99999.

tools.name: build_cohort_features
tools.title: Build subject feature table
tools.description: Join an explicit saved design version to a saved diversity result from its dataset; retain raw subject/group observations, units, missingness and provenance without pooling or testing.

design.description: Saved project cohort design record ID, including its version suffix.

diversity.description: Saved diversity artifact ID from the same dataset.

tools.name: check_cohort_design
tools.title: Check a cohort design
tools.description: Shows Cohort and checks explicit groups, subjects, pairing and exclusions. Optionally saves a versioned design snapshot; computes no inferential test.

dataset.description: A dataset of the project by name or id; the one in focus, else the first, if not given.

save.description: Save a completed design check (including failed checks, unavailable for inference) in the project (default false).

spec.description: {unit: subject, layout: independent|paired, groupField: condition|timepoint|tissue|cellSubset, levels: [reference, comparison], exclude: {sample: reason}}. Exact group labels; no automatic pooling.

tools.name: get_state
tools.title: Describe the project
tools.description: The open project: its datasets (format, unit, rows, samples, findings, filter, clonotype definition, license and citation of public data), the view shown, the item in focus, and the example datasets with whether each is downloaded.

tools.name: new_project
tools.title: Start a new project
tools.description: Starts a new, empty project (the open one is saved).

tools.name: open_data
tools.title: Open data
tools.description: Opens files or folders on this computer as one dataset of the project: AIRR rearrangement tables with their Repertoire metadata (.json), Cell Ranger V(D)J output folders or contig annotations, immunoSEQ exports; another tool's CSV or TSV through a mapping of its columns. Needs the token.

mappings.description: For tables ClonoLoom does not recognize, by path: {columns: {junction_aa, junction, v_call, d_call, j_call, c_call, count, sample, locus, productive, cell_id, clone_id, sequence_id: the column's name}, unit: reads | umis | templates | cells (when a count is mapped), sample: the sample's name when no column holds it}.

paths.description: Absolute paths, read together as one dataset.

tools.name: open_example
tools.title: Open an example dataset
tools.description: Opens one of the example datasets as a dataset of the project. One not yet downloaded is downloaded first when download is true and its data are openly licensed; data under a provider's terms of use are downloaded only by the person, who accepts the terms in the window.

download.description: Download it first if it is not downloaded (openly licensed data only).

example.description: The example's name, such as 10x-pbmc-1k (get_state lists them).

opening.description: What of it to open, such as "T cells" (its first if not given).

tools.name: show
tools.title: Show a view
tools.description: Shows a view (start, data, qc, clonotypes, repertoire, tracking, specificity, cohort, reports, jobs), with a dataset in focus.

dataset.description: A dataset of the project by name or id; the one in focus, else the first, if not given.

view.description: start, data, qc, clonotypes, repertoire, tracking, specificity, cohort, reports or jobs.

tools.name: set_definition
tools.title: Define clonotypes
tools.description: Chooses a dataset's clonotype definition: a preset by name, or one stated in full.

dataset.description: A dataset of the project by name or id; the one in focus, else the first, if not given.

definition.description: A definition in full: {name, chains: [] | [locus] | [locus, locus|"light"], junction: aa|nt, v: allele|gene|family|none, j: …, cells: primary|all, requireAll, productiveOnly, vendor}.

preset.description: A preset's name (or part of it), such as "Paired αβ" or "Nucleotide junction".

tools.name: annotate_samples
tools.title: Annotate samples
tools.description: Sets samples' annotation, as the Data view's samples table holds it: each one's subject, time point (day 28, week 4, baseline), reference role (infusion product, donor), tissue, cell subset, condition, batch and HLA. An empty value removes a field; fields not named are left as they are.

dataset.description: A dataset of the project by name or id; the one in focus, else the first, if not given.

samples.description: By sample name: {subject, timepoint, reference, tissue, cellSubset, condition, batch, hla: a value, or "" to remove it}.

tools.name: describe_subjects
tools.title: Describe the subjects
tools.description: Shows the Tracking view and answers the dataset's subjects as the program reads their annotation: each one's samples in time order with their time points read as days from the subject's reference event, its reference samples and the samples taken at one time (replicates), and the checks' findings (samples without a subject or a time point, time points not understood, subjects without a reference sample).

dataset.description: A dataset of the project by name or id; the one in focus, else the first, if not given.

tools.name: track_clonotypes
tools.title: Follow clonotypes over time
tools.description: Shows the Tracking view's Clonotypes part and follows clonotypes through each subject's samples in time order, under the dataset's clonotype definition and filter (a job; the result kept with the project): each subject's reference sample's largest clonotypes (the default; each sample's largest for a subject without one), each sample's largest, a list, or those a test called. Answers each subject's time points and, for each clonotype followed, why it was chosen and its count, frequency and 95% interval (Wilson's) at each time point, the samples taken at one time pooled.

by.description: reference (each reference sample's n largest; the default), largest (each sample's n largest), list, test (the n clonotypes the dataset's comparison called, the most significant first: see test_expansion), or class (the n clonotypes of a class against the dataset's base time point: see class_clonotypes).

class.description: With by class: emerging (the default), transient, contracting or persistent.

dataset.description: A dataset of the project by name or id; the one in focus, else the first, if not given.

list.description: With by list: the clonotypes, by ID (c-…) or junction (CASSLAGGPEAFF; a paired clonotype's chains joined by "; ").

n.description: How many: 10 of a reference sample, 5 of each sample and 20 of a test's calls by default, at most 100.

subject.description: The subject to show (the first by default).

tools.name: test_expansion
tools.title: Test clonotypes between two time points
tools.description: Shows the Tracking view's Tests part and tests each clonotype between two time points of each subject (the samples at one time pooled), under the dataset's clonotype definition and filter (a job; the result kept with the project): the beta-binomial test conditional on the clonotype's total, its variance fitted on the study's replicate samples or two time points named as stable (the default where it can be fitted; else the binomial test), the binomial test, or Fisher's exact test, two-sided or one-sided, the false discovery rate controlled within each subject by Benjamini–Hochberg (the default) or Storey's q-values; clonotypes with fewer than 5 cells or molecules in the two together are not tested. Answers the test used and the variance model fitted, each subject's clonotypes tested, left out, increased and decreased, and the most significant calls. The tests refuse reads.

alpha.description: The false discovery rate at which a clonotype is called: 0.01 by default.

alternative.description: two-sided (the default), increase (more at the second time point) or decrease.

calls.description: How many of each subject's calls to answer (10 by default).

correction.description: bh (Benjamini–Hochberg; the default) or storey (Storey's q-values).

dataset.description: A dataset of the project by name or id; the one in focus, else the first, if not given.

from.description: The first time point, by its key as the subjects' samples give it (describe_subjects): day 0, day -7, baseline, reference (the reference sample), visit 2.

stable.description: Two time points between which the clonotypes are taken not to change, to fit the beta-binomial test's variance on instead of the replicate samples: ["day -7", "day 0"]; [] for the replicate samples.

subject.description: The subject to show (the first by default).

test.description: auto (the beta-binomial test where its variance can be fitted, else the binomial test; the default), betabinomial, binomial or fisher.

tools.name: class_clonotypes
tools.title: Class clonotypes across time points
tools.description: Shows the Tracking view's Classes part and, in each subject, tests each clonotype between a base time point and every later one by the dataset's test (as test_expansion chose it; the beta-binomial test where its variance can be fitted), and classes it by its calls: emerging (called increased at the last time point), transient (called changed at a time point between, not at the last), contracting (called decreased at the last) or persistent (never called, found at every time point). A job; the result kept with the project. Answers each subject's clonotypes by class and the most significant of a class.

base.description: The base time point, by its key (day -7, baseline): the first other than the reference sample's by default.

class.description: The class to show and answer: emerging (the default), transient, contracting or persistent.

count.description: How many of the class to answer in each subject (10 by default).

dataset.description: A dataset of the project by name or id; the one in focus, else the first, if not given.

subject.description: The subject to show (the first by default).

tools.name: attribute_samples
tools.title: Attribute samples to the reference
tools.description: Shows the Tracking view's Attribution part and measures each sample of each subject with a reference sample (an infusion product, a donor) under the dataset's clonotype definition and filter (a job; the result kept with the project): its share in the clonotypes the reference sample holds, and, where the subject has samples before the reference event and the reference shares few clonotypes with them (a donor), the share derived from the reference, each with its 95% interval (Wilson's). Answers each subject's time points, the share before the event and the reference's overlap with it.

dataset.description: A dataset of the project by name or id; the one in focus, else the first, if not given.

tools.name: find_neighbors
tools.title: Find similar receptors by TCRdist
tools.description: Shows the Specificity view's Neighbors part and compares each T-cell clonotype of the dataset with every other of the same chains by TCRdist, as tcrdist3 computes it, under the dataset's clonotype definition and filter (a job; the result kept with the project): with the V genes' CDR1, CDR2 and CDR2.5 (the reference data tcrdist3-loops, which must be downloaded) or the CDR3s alone. The options given are kept with the dataset. Answers how many clonotypes were compared and have a neighbor within the radius, and the clonotypes with the most neighbors; with select, the chosen clonotype's nearest, loop by loop.

cdr3Only.description: Compare the CDR3s alone, without the V genes' loops.

dataset.description: A dataset of the project by name or id; the one in focus, else the first, if not given.

organism.description: Whose loops: human, mouse or rhesus (default: guessed from the V genes).

radius.description: The radius within which two clonotypes are neighbors, in TCRdist units (default: 24 a chain).

select.description: A clonotype to show the nearest of, by its rank among those with the most neighbors (from 1).

top.description: How many of the clonotypes with the most neighbors to answer (default 10).

tools.name: match_specificity
tools.title: Match specificity evidence
tools.description: Matches retained chains against a downloaded VDJdb release or the generated vaccine database, and shows per-epitope sample shares. Never downloads a database implicitly. Optionally follows one epitope's matched clonotypes in Tracking.

dataset.description: A dataset of the project by name or id; the one in focus, else the first, if not given.

genes.description: Require matching V and J calls

tools.name: measure_bcell_shm
tools.title: Measure somatic hypermutation
tools.description: Compare saved D-masked germlines with source rows. Reports evaluable bases/codons, regional substitutions, single-hit R/S and unclassified changes.

dataset.description: A dataset of the project by name or id; the one in focus, else the first, if not given.

germlines.description: Saved germlines artifact ID; latest result if omitted

tools.name: summarize_bcell_isotypes
tools.title: Summarize B-cell isotypes
tools.description: Count observed heavy constant calls by sample and family, retaining ambiguity and missing abundance. Unordered family co-occurrence is not switching-event inference.

dataset.description: A dataset of the project by name or id; the one in focus, else the first, if not given.

families.description: Saved thresholded families artifact ID; latest result if omitted

tools.name: build_bcell_lineages
tools.title: Build B-cell lineage trees
tools.description: Build family/locus parsimony trees from saved germlines, with conditional ancestral states and observed metadata. Exact through 8 states; bounded heuristic through 64.

dataset.description: A dataset of the project by name or id; the one in focus, else the first, if not given.

germlines.description: Saved germlines artifact ID; latest result if omitted

tools.name: reconstruct_bcell_germlines
tools.title: Reconstruct D-masked B-cell germlines
tools.description: Uses saved thresholded families and checked ungapped references. Preserves indels, masks D/N/P, and records exclusions and provenance.

dataset.description: A dataset of the project by name or id; the one in focus, else the first, if not given.

families.description: Saved families artifact ID; latest thresholded result if omitted

tools.name: find_bcell_families
tools.title: Find B-cell clonal families
tools.description: Measures nearest distinct-receptor distances, and assigns single-linkage families only with an explicit threshold. Respects subject or sample boundaries; paired mode uses both chains. Keeps a cited immutable result.

dataset.description: A dataset of the project by name or id; the one in focus, else the first, if not given.

threshold.description: Inclusive normalized distance 0–1. Omit for distances only; zero means exact identity.

tools.name: compare_receptor_expression
tools.title: Compare receptor and expression neighborhoods
tools.description: CoNGA-style paired alpha-beta clonotype graph comparison with tied neighbors, conditional overlap tests and all-scale Bonferroni correction.

cdr3Only.description: Explicitly omit V-germline loops; false requires organism and reference

organism.description: human or mouse; required for full TCRdist

phenotypes.description: Saved computed-map phenotype artifact; displayed result if omitted

tools.name: compute_clonotype_modularity
tools.title: Compute clonotype modularity
tools.description: Test within-clone connectivity on a saved expression graph, using size-matched subsets and BY-adjusted p-values.

phenotypes.description: Saved computed-map phenotype artifact; the displayed phenotype result if omitted

tools.name: compare_pseudobulk
tools.title: Compare paired pseudobulk expression
tools.description: Within-subject gene expression for one type/timepoint and two declared size categories. Requires 25 complete pairs; median-ratio offsets, unmoderated NB2, conditional intervals and explicit BH family.

exclude.description: Sample names mapped to explicit exclusion reasons

tools.name: aggregate_pseudobulk
tools.title: Aggregate pseudobulk counts
tools.description: Exact raw expression sums by subject, sample, supplied type and receptor size category; no differential expression test.

phenotypes.description: Explicit saved phenotype IDs, one per sample

tools.name: export_anndata
tools.title: Prepare AnnData export
tools.description: Save raw sparse counts with exact receptor links, annotations, saved embeddings and provenance; download from Cells.

phenotypes.description: Saved phenotype artifact; displayed result if omitted

tools.name: compute_cell_phenotypes
tools.title: Compute clonotype phenotypes
tools.description: Save sample-scoped clonotype sizes, map overlays and supplied phenotype counts for the open expression input and its receptor binding.

annotation.description: Supplied phenotype column; empty summarizes the sample

map.description: Computed expression-map artifact ID, latest for the open input, or empty for imported coordinates

tools.name: compute_expression_map
tools.title: Compute expression map
tools.description: Normalize the open expression input, compute PCA, exact neighbors and UMAP, and save an immutable result. Open expression evidence first.

minGenes.description: Minimum detected genes per cell; default 1

tools.name: inspect_expression
tools.title: Inspect expression evidence
tools.description: Open a MEX, 10x HDF5, AnnData or MuData input and check exact barcode coverage in an explicit receptor sample. Saves source fingerprints; no normalization or clonotype inference.

anndata.description: Explicit AnnData/MuData selections; layer is X or layers/<name>

airrModality.description: Required AIRR modality for MuData when AIRR key is given

anndataExample.description: Use the generated artificial AnnData example

cellsPath.description: Optional cell annotation TSV for MEX/10x HDF5 on this computer

dataset.description: A dataset of the project by name or id; the one in focus, else the first, if not given.

example.description: Use the already generated artificial expression example

hdf5Example.description: Use the already generated artificial HDF5 expression example

path.description: MEX directory or 10x HDF5 file on this computer

sample.description: Explicit zero-based receptor sample index; dataset empty for expression only

studyExample.description: Use the generated cell-states study, first expression sample and its annotations

tools.name: inspect_bcell_inputs
tools.title: Inspect B-cell inputs
tools.description: Shows B cells, the filtered rearrangement evidence counts and a bounded first page. Optionally inspects one row. Does not reconstruct germlines or measure mutation.

dataset.description: A dataset of the project by name or id; the one in focus, else the first, if not given.

select.description: Rearrangement on the first page to inspect, from 1 (at most 50).

tools.name: flag_invariant
tools.title: Flag invariant populations
tools.description: Evaluate published MAIT, iNKT and GEM sequence rules for an explicit species. Shows Clonotypes, optionally narrowed to a matched population, and answers sample totals, evaluable abundance and shares. Records the species with the dataset; flags do not establish phenotype or specificity.

dataset.description: A dataset of the project by name or id; the one in focus, else the first, if not given.

population.description: MAIT, iNKT, GEM, or empty for all clonotypes

tools.name: find_networks
tools.title: Find clonotype networks
tools.description: Finds connected components of clonotypes joined within a sequence-distance cutoff, retaining all edges and memberships independently of the drawing. Shows Networks in Specificity and answers component counts. Options are kept with the dataset.

arms.description: all retained chains or any shared chain

cutoff.description: 0 for identity, 0–2 for edit distance, 0–1000 for TCRdist

dataset.description: A dataset of the project by name or id; the one in focus, else the first, if not given.

sameJ.description: Require the same J gene at the definition's resolution

sameV.description: Require the same V gene at the definition's resolution

tools.name: find_neighborhoods
tools.title: Find neighborhoods against a background
tools.description: Shows the Specificity view's Neighborhoods part and finds, for each receptor of one locus, the largest radius at which a background holds few enough receptors and the dataset's receptors within it (a job; the result kept with the project), as Mayer-Blackwell et al. 2021 define a neighborhood. The background is drawn from a recombination model with the dataset's V and J usage, or made by moving the dataset's own CDR3s among its genes. The options given are kept with the dataset. Answers how many receptors have a neighborhood and the first by enrichment, each with its radius, its neighborhood's receptors, how much commoner it is than in the background, and its motif.

background.description: model (drawn from a recombination model; the default) or shuffled (the dataset's own CDR3s moved among its genes).

control.description: The share of the background a radius may hold: 1e-5, 1e-6 (the default) or 1e-7.

dataset.description: A dataset of the project by name or id; the one in focus, else the first, if not given.

locus.description: The locus whose chains are compared (default: the dataset's commonest).

minNeighbors.description: How many receptors a neighborhood needs to be reported, its centroid counted (default 2).

order.description: Which neighborhoods first: enriched (the default), neighbors or abundant.

select.description: A neighborhood to show the receptors of, by its rank in the order asked for (from 1).

tools.name: measure_generation
tools.title: Compute generation probabilities
tools.description: Shows the Specificity view's Generation part and computes each clonotype's generation probability, the probability that V(D)J recombination alone makes its CDR3s, as OLGA computes it, under the dataset's clonotype definition and filter (a job; the result kept with the project): under OLGA's default models (the reference data olga-models, which must be downloaded) or ClonoLoom's own model of human TRB; a pair's is the product of its chains'. The options given are kept with the dataset. Answers the models and how many clonotypes have a probability, each sample's quartiles (log10), and the first clonotypes in the order asked for.

dataset.description: A dataset of the project by name or id; the one in focus, else the first, if not given.

genes.description: The probability of each CDR3 with its V and J genes, not of the CDR3 alone.

models.description: Whose models: olga, clonoloom, or "" for OLGA's where downloaded, else ClonoLoom's (the default).

order.description: Which clonotypes first: abundant (the default), probable or improbable.

organism.description: human or mouse, or "" to guess from the V genes (the default).

tools.name: select_clonotype
tools.title: Choose a clonotype
tools.description: Shows the Clonotypes view and chooses a clonotype, which the inspector describes: by its rank in the table (1 for the first) or its ID.

dataset.description: A dataset of the project by name or id; the one in focus, else the first, if not given.

rank.description: Its rank in the table as sorted, from 1.

tools.name: measure_diversity
tools.title: Measure diversity
tools.description: Shows the Repertoire view and measures each sample's diversity under the dataset's clonotype definition and filter (a job; the result kept with the project), answering each sample's main measures with their 95% intervals: clonotypes seen, Chao1, the Shannon and Simpson diversity seen and estimated, clonality, Simpson clonality, Gini and coverage.

dataset.description: A dataset of the project by name or id; the one in focus, else the first, if not given.

tools.name: rarefy
tools.title: Rarefy and extrapolate
tools.description: Shows the Repertoire view's Rarefaction part and computes each sample's rarefaction and extrapolation curves under the dataset's clonotype definition and filter (a job; the result kept with the project), answering the levels the samples are best compared at and each sample's clonotypes, Shannon diversity and Simpson diversity at the level chosen, with their 95% intervals.

dataset.description: A dataset of the project by name or id; the one in focus, else the first, if not given.

level.description: Where the samples are compared: coverage (the lowest sample coverage among them; the default), size (the smallest sample's), extrapolatedCoverage or extrapolatedSize (iNEXT's defaults, reached by extrapolating to twice a sample's size).

tools.name: gene_usage
tools.title: Count genes and junctions
tools.description: Shows the Repertoire view's Genes or Junctions part and counts each sample's V, D, J and C genes, junction lengths and amino acids under the dataset's clonotype definition and filter (a job; the result kept with the project, the samples grouped by condition), answering for each sample (or condition) the most used genes of a segment, the commonest junction lengths and the mean length, with their 95% intervals (for a condition, its samples' range).

dataset.description: A dataset of the project by name or id; the one in focus, else the first, if not given.

rows.description: samples (the default) or groups (the samples' conditions).

segment.description: V (the default), D, J or C.

weight.description: clonotypes (each counted once; the default) or abundance.

tools.name: measure_overlap
tools.title: Measure overlap
tools.description: Shows the Repertoire view's Overlap part and measures every pair of samples' overlap under the dataset's clonotype definition and filter (a job; the result kept with the project, the samples' subjects and conditions from their annotation or metadata), answering the pairs of one subject and of two summarized, the most overlapping pairs by a measure with their 95% intervals, and how many clonotypes are found in one subject, two, and more.

dataset.description: A dataset of the project by name or id; the one in focus, else the first, if not given.

measure.description: morisita (the default), morisitaHorn, jaccard, jaccardRarefied, sorensen, sorensenRarefied, overlap, overlapRarefied, shared, sharedRarefied or abundance.

pairs.description: How many of the most overlapping pairs to answer (10 by default).

tools.name: show_examples
tools.title: Show the example data
tools.description: Opens the Example data dialog.

tools.name: show_methods
tools.title: Write the methods paragraph
tools.description: Shows a dataset's methods paragraph and answers it with its references.

dataset.description: A dataset of the project by name or id; the one in focus, else the first, if not given.

tools.name: set_theme
tools.title: Choose the theme
tools.description: Light, dark or the system's.

tools.name: close_dialogs
tools.title: Close dialogs
tools.description: Closes any dialog, menu or toast open in the window.
